connector.name: Storylenses
connector.registryDescription: AI cover letter generation for agents. Job analysis, profile matching, narrative letters.
connector.summary: Hosted at storylenses.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the benediktgirz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: StoryLenses API key (get one at storylenses.app/developers)
